title: Centralizers in finite groups and Domination number of their commuting graphs
summary: The proper commuting graph $\mathcal{C}^{**}(G)$ of a finite group $G$ is the simple graph whose vertices are the noncentral elements of $G$ and two distinct vertices are adjacent if they commute. In this paper, we study the domination number and total domination number of proper commuting graphs of finite groups. We first obtain general bounds for the domination number of proper commuting graphs.
